title: Example Cases — SampleWiki
goal: Turn source-pinned SampleWiki problems and proofs into reviewed Lean theorems and reusable ASTIS proof-technique nodes without confusing crawling, compilation, semantic review, and graph assimilation.
admission_rule: Only sourceReviewed or assimilated cases are eligible to feed the scientific ASTIS theorem graph.
source_policy: Track structural metadata and cryptographic fingerprints automatically; write original ASTIS mathematical restatements for reviewed cases rather than mirroring long upstream prose.
